# InstaCollage — Instagram Posts & Carousels to Ready Collages in 1 Click
> High-performance Progressive Web App (PWA) to turn Instagram posts and multi-slide carousels into studio-ready photo collages, polaroid moodboards, and filmstrips in one click.

- **Developer**: Mahmoud Madi (https://github.com/mahmoud-madi)
- **Powered by**: Premier Tech & Voxo AI
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mahmoud-madi/instagram-carousel-to-collage
- **Repository Type**: Open-Source Web Application & API
- **License**: MIT
- **Tech Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Canvas 2D API, Node.js, Express, CSS3 Glassmorphism, IndexedDB, JSZip.

---

## 🎯 What It Does
InstaCollage allows users to input any public Instagram carousel URL (or use native mobile Web Share Target), extracts all individual high-resolution slides without cropping, and renders them onto customizable, high-DPI photo collages, Polaroid scrapbook moodboards, and cinematic filmstrips in real time.

---

## 🔑 Core Features
1. **Multi-Tier Scraper**: SSR HTML crawler and meta graph fallback extracting uncropped 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, and 9:16 portrait images.
2. **SSRF-Hardened CORS Media Proxy**: Secure upstream image streaming with private IP rejection (`127.0.0.1`, `10.0.0.0/8`, `192.168.0.0/16`, AWS metadata `169.254.169.254`).
3. **Adaptive Canvas Aspect Ratio Engine**: Calculates dynamic canvas and tile dimensions to match slide aspect ratios with zero unwanted bars and zero cropping.
4. **Artistic Collage Modes**:
   - Standard Responsive Grid Matrix (1 to 6 columns / rows)
   - Polaroid Scrapbook (Organic tilt rotations, white photo borders, and drop shadows)
   - Cinema 35mm Filmstrip (Kodak/Fuji perforations, frame counters, and date stamps)
   - Masonry Flow (Dynamic pin-style photo wall)
5. **Color & Aesthetic Filters**: Real-time canvas pixel grading (Vivid, 90s Vintage, Kodak Sepia, Cyber Mono, Dramatic Noir, Pastel Fade).
6. **Local IndexedDB Vault**: Persistent local offline history drawer for quick re-rendering and bulk exporting.
7. **High-DPI Ultra 4K Exporter**: Lossless PNG, high-res JPEG with custom compression, native clipboard copy, and server-side multi-threaded ZIP archiving.

---

## 🚀 Fast Start
```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/mahmoud-madi/instagram-carousel-to-collage.git
cd instagram-carousel-to-collage

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start local server
npm start
# -> Studio is live at http://localhost:3300
```
